ios.desc:
Supanator is a native Supabase client for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Browse tables, run SQL on your PostgreSQL database, monitor every project and get a push notification the moment something goes down.

DATABASE MANAGEMENT
Browse schemas, tables and columns. View, add, edit and delete rows with an editor that understands data types and constraints. Explore table relationships in an interactive diagram and manage Row Level Security policies to keep your data secure.

SQL EDITOR & QUERY BUILDER
Run SQL directly against your database, from simple reads to complex updates. Save snippets, export results to CSV and get a warning before destructive operations. Prefer a visual approach? Use the built-in query builder instead of writing raw SQL.

AGENTIC AI
Get help writing SQL, designing schemas and creating RLS policies. The AI assistant understands your project structure and gives suggestions based on your actual database.

REALTIME & MONITORING
Watch live inserts, updates and deletes from your tables in real time. Track project health, database activity, API usage, CPU, memory, connections and logs. Review security and performance advisors.

PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Get an alert when your project goes down, recovers or reports an unhealthy status. Choose which categories notify you: project health, database, auth, edge functions and storage. Monitoring runs on our servers, so alerts arrive even when the app is closed.

STORAGE MANAGEMENT
Browse buckets and folders, upload files from Files or Photos, preview images, PDFs and videos, and manage bucket permissions.

AUTH & SECURITY
Monitor users, manage identity settings and configure OAuth providers. View roles and privileges, and sign in with OAuth or a management token. Credentials are stored in the Keychain, with optional Face ID or Touch ID protection.

SELF-HOSTED SUPPORT
Connect to self-hosted Supabase alongside Supabase Cloud or instead of it. Works with the official Docker setup, Kubernetes, the Supabase CLI and custom Postgres. Advanced settings cover reverse proxies, self-signed certificates and basic auth. Your data stays where it is.

EDGE FUNCTIONS, APIS & MORE
Manage edge functions, secrets and environment variables. Browse triggers and database functions, read generated REST API docs with cURL and Swift examples, manage API keys and access backups with point-in-time recovery.

quotes.text:
I built Supanator to work with Supabase on the go. It’s a developer tool that now includes Supanator AI, which you can chat with directly to get help writing queries, designing schemas, troubleshooting auth issues, and more, tailored to your specific Supabase project. You can paste the queries straight to the SQL editor without needing to copy/paste manually.

For privacy: Supanator uses OpenAI under the hood, but only metadata (like table names and types) is sent. Your actual data never leaves your project.

My goal is to save developers time and reduce context-switching when building with Supabase. Would love feedback on what’s most useful (or missing) so far!
